restrictions: Ordinary collision of SHA-256 reduced to 39 steps from the standard IV: two 128-byte messages with the same random first block M0 and second blocks M1, M1' = M1 + DL (differences in words 8..12), then the common padding block. The second block is the transplanted advice pair with A[6], A[7] released over a list generated at import by rule on the fibre h4 = 0x3cc9eebe: 9,701,592 entries in 728 classes, 3,462,264 (a2, W10) keys; the walk constants c9, C9 are shifted by 0x05cefde0. The W17 condition is solved per F9 claw by a generic bit-sliced pass over the 62,400 distinct 18-bit prefixes; a passing prefix is completed, tested on scalar words and, at a key hit, expanded to the classes of its group.

Our w13 program with the list re-based to a new fibre and generated by rule (no recipe). Trials are F8-passing entries under the mate model H7 of a7b383d1 (credited): 10598.2 per distinct claw, the 99% lower bound of our count on 2,000 F9 claws; only the first key hit of each window is counted (w13); keys-only fallback 8956.4 (time 94.4186). Walk table 99,328 slots of 40 bits; walk statistics from 48 full windows of the shipped program. Time 94.1758: work cap (K = 10,719, 1% above its formula; pass 143,633), setup 1,107,473,556 operations, 2^43 preprocessing. Tail 2^-74.54 (declared; paired transfer arm -0.014 bit, s.e. 0.023). Memory 2^20.0000: peak over phases 1,013,513 bytes plus 32,768. Advice 160 bytes. Success 0.39.

heuristics.statement: For the selected-window distribution of the shipped program (KCAP=710, KTRY=32), the expected charged base-walk work per window is at most 472,362,354 operations and the distinct evaluated F9 claws per window are at most 910.38 on average, 0.015969 per distinct claw at the unit of 57,010.58 groups per window. Chaining values of random first blocks behave as independent uniform values for the walk map and the later events; W17 is uniform over claws and listed keys; survivors of the pass per evaluated claw are at most 0.23995 in expectation, the one-sided 99% bound of this entry's count on 48 full windows (10,114 survivors in 43,134 evaluated claws). The uniform model gives 62,400 x 2^-18 = 0.23804, shown for comparison.
heuristics.scope: The fixed target sha256-r39-prefix-v1 and experiments/r39joint_k4.py with the shipped advice pair and the list generated at import.
heuristics.extrapolation: One-sided 99% bounds from this entry's own full windows of the shipped program: 24 for the base walk (mean 469,984,814, s.d. 4,659,006), 48 for the F9 claws (mean 898.62, s.d. 33.81) and G. Extended to 2^76.444270 windows by independence of first blocks.
heuristics.limitations: Samples of 24 and 48 windows on public seeds run by this entry; the organizer runs four windows of 2^21 evaluations of the same walk. Each premise at its own 99% bound.

heuristics.statement: The W17 pass costs exactly 143,633 operations per evaluated F9 claw: 733 + sum over the 200 groups of (110 + 403 x blocks), a formula of the table evaluated and asserted by the program, with no folded or claw-specialised code. A survivor costs 711 + 563 per class tested, at most 5,215; a key hit at most 49,472 (the at most 8 classes of its group as mates); the one-time setup, the rule generator included, is charged 1,107,473,556 operations. K = 10,719 is at least 1 percent above its formula.
heuristics.scope: The counted pass, survivor and key-hit paths and setup of experiments/r39joint_k4.py.
heuristics.extrapolation: Exact counts of the program; the organizer run asserts the pass cost per claw and planted survivor costs.
heuristics.limitations: The 2^30 part of the setup is an allowance for the import's other statements.

heuristics.statement: For a valid listed entry of the fibre 0x3cc9eebe passing F8 in a claw passing F9 with W17 equal to the advice value, the two 39-step compressions give equal outputs with probability at least 2^-74.54, the declared bound QDECL of the shipped replica (below its hard-asserted one-sided 99.9% bound 2^-74.4326; 42 further runs: mean 2^-74.4434, 99.9% bound 2^-74.5296). Real variants of the new fibre do not lower it: paired joint arm against h0 variants, 28 organizer-protocol runs with identical SMC carrier, log2 ratio -0.014 (s.e. 0.023), one-sided 99% bound on the loss 0.071 bit; class-01-only -0.021. Priced directly on the new fibre, the R 3cc9eebe arm alone (28 runs) has the one-sided 99.9% bound 2^-74.4804, above the declared value; its claws are real F9 claws of the shifted walk from windows of an earlier build (seed 1000: 908 F9 claws there, 871 in the shipped program).
heuristics.scope: Rows 18 to 38 of the advice trail after rows 0 to 17 hold; parity classes pooled as in 5f8e6192.
heuristics.extrapolation: The R arms draw (claw, entry) uniformly over F8-passing pairs, so they weight by entries, the H7 trial weighting; every hit verified by recompressing both blocks.
heuristics.limitations: The transfer is a 28-run paired arm, not a proof of equality; the attack's trials are all of class 01 (a0 even, W1 odd), whose paired figure is -0.021.

heuristics.statement: A[8..11], E[12..15] and W12..W15 are fixed to the advice values; (A[6], A[7]) range over the listed entries of the fibre 0x3cc9eebe; for every listed entry both messages follow the advice state-difference trail through step 15, W9 is C9 + 0x05cefde0 - a1 and W16 is one value per claw. Constructing and selecting the advice pair costs at most 2^43 compressions (2^42.545 by the accounting of proof Section 9), added to the claimed time; the offline fibre search costs at most about 2^31.1 compressions (estimated from the tools' loop counts), inside the remaining 2^41.1.
heuristics.scope: The one-time construction of the 160-byte advice pair of 5f8e6192; the list is generated at import by the rule of proof Section 2.5.
heuristics.extrapolation: Exhaustive enumeration over all 2^32 a3 with the real two-message trail checked on every entry at four points (0 failures); the rule reproduces that list exactly; the organizer run checks one entry of every group at the advice point.
heuristics.limitations: The 93-pair campaign was run by the pair's authors and is charged at its declared cost.

heuristics.statement: Windows are independent (fresh first blocks). Trials are F8-passing listed entries in claws passing F9, counted under the mate model H7 of a7b383d1 (credited): at least 10598.2 per distinct claw, the one-sided 99% lower bound of this entry's count on 2,000 real F9 claws of the shipped program. Given the claws of a window, the W17 events of distinct keys are independent with probability 2^-32 each. Only the first key hit of each window is counted (w13's rule): the budget divides lambda by 1 - 0.06132, the share of key hits beyond the first; the F8-passing entries of that key are its trials. No independence between the tails of different key hits is used. Keys-only fallback: 8956.4 per distinct claw, time 94.4186 under the same rule.
heuristics.scope: The amplification over 2^76.444269 windows of the shipped program.
heuristics.extrapolation: Entries passing F8 per F9 claw 682,518.4 (s.e. 1,205.5, 16 batches of 125 claws); per-claw s.d. 70,200; F9 claws per window from 48 windows.
heuristics.limitations: The entries count rests on H7 (mates share survival through step 19, independent from step 20 on), held valid in a7b383d1; the keys-only count needs no within-key premise.

heuristics.statement: Mean work per window is at most 605,977,191 operations against the cap 611,096,407 (margin 0.84%), and the per-window s.d. is at most 14,621,707, with each of the four sample moments at its one-sided 99.75% bound (99% jointly). For independent windows Chebyshev bounds the probability that the cap binds before B windows below 8.0e-23.
heuristics.extrapolation: From 24 and 48 full windows of the shipped program.
heuristics.limitations: Normal-theory bounds on the sample moments.

heuristics.statement: Given the claws, the W17 events of distinct keys are dispersed as independent trials. Tested in the organizer run at a scaled event of probability 2^-7 on every key of four groups (every 50th) with an entry in F8, in every F9 claw of the four organizer windows: 146,502 key events, 1,104 hits against 1144.5 expected (z = -1.20), Pearson 19.29 on 22 claws; acceptance region fixed in the manifest and asserted.
heuristics.scope: Four of the 200 groups, all F9 claws of the four organizer windows of r39k4-window-small.
heuristics.extrapolation: The attack's event has probability 2^-32 on the same keys and words.
heuristics.limitations: Four groups only, for run time; the groups are fixed by the program.

heuristics.statement: MODEL (declared; the mate premise of a7b383d1, credited): each F8-passing mate of a W17-hit key succeeds with marginal probability at least p_tail (the per-entry marginal measured by the R arm, which weights by entries), and the probability that at least one of the at most 8 mates succeeds equals the sum of the marginals up to the pairwise term, which is at most 7 x p_tail / P19 < 2^-58 relative if mates' tails are dependent at most through rows 18-19 (P19 >= 2^-13.43). a7b383d1's shared-rows form is a special case; on this list mates differ in W11 and W3..W8, so rows 18-19 are not literally shared. Every F8-passing entry of the first hit key counts as a trial. Measured entries per F8-passing key: 1.1834.
heuristics.scope: The k = 4 list of the fibre 0x3cc9eebe.
heuristics.extrapolation: The mate model of a7b383d1 (under review), applied here to the first key hit of each window only.
heuristics.limitations: If H7 is not granted, the keys-only fallback applies (time 94.4186).
